label: Government and directing to an end: Government orders things governed to an end consisting in some…
term: government and directing to an end
definition: Government orders things governed to an end consisting in some good. Directs d x e represents d’s directing x toward e; Governs d x represents government of x by d. The encoded q.103 a.3 reading uses only directing-implies-governing. Q.103 a.6 distinguishes the design, or providence, from its execution through intermediaries. Neither this definition nor that text says every mover of a director in any respect directs its effects.
